name: snapback-selfheal
title: Snapback Self-Heal
description: Your AI agent self-heals: on ANY error it auto-diagnoses against Snapback's curated library (46 infrastructure families, free, no LLM, <150ms) and applies the fix ONLY when it's high-confidence, library-sourced, and reversible (the three-factor gate) — otherwise escalates to a human. Never auto-applies a state-changing or destructive fix. 100% client-side, free diagnosis, no token required, zero dependencies.
author: Snapback / RA1 Labs

permissions.notes: Text-only skill. Reads SKILL.md instructions and calls the free public diagnose_infra_error MCP endpoint. No local filesystem or shell access. Sends only the error string you pass; Snapback also scrubs server-side.

env.SNAPBACK_TOKEN: optional — a vdk_ token from https://snapback.sh, only needed to meter diagnose_trace / report outcomes; the diagnosis tools are free and need no token

usage:
from snapback_interceptor import SnapbackInterceptor
heal = SnapbackInterceptor(auto_apply=True)
result = heal.run(my_tool_call, *args, **kwargs)   # auto-diagnose + safe-retry on error

safety.gate_contract: auto-apply ONLY when confidence>=0.85 AND source=='library' AND action_class in {retry,refetch,config}; NEVER auto-apply mutate/destructive; fails closed (escalate when unsure)
